# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Revalidated the pending molt/mineral amendments against the current HEAD and found the runtime-side reserve/condition parameterization, exact molt-cadence handling, high-GH diagnostics, and failed-molt documentation were already present in the branch. The implementation work in this pass focused on the remaining fallout: I restored `rol_rate_cm_per_g` default materialization in `tank_scenarios`, tightened the controlled ideal reproduction regression back to non-zero day-60/day-90 colony floors, and hardened the reproduction-budget fixtures so they isolate hatch/accounting behavior from unrelated mortality and molt noise while still exercising deterministic shrimp reproduction.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Audited the current branch against the pending amendments and confirmed the shrimp runtime already carries the named reserve/condition knobs, exact timer cadence fix, high-GH molt diagnostics, and the intentional failed-molt dual-contribution comments, so the remaining work narrowed to broken fixtures and downstream regression drift.
2. [Completed] Patched `tank_scenarios` process preset materialization to carry the missing `rol_rate_cm_per_g` default so scenario and harness builds compile cleanly again.
3. [Completed] Retightened the controlled ideal reproduction harness by disabling unrelated shrimp mortality paths, extending molt intervals for that idealized hatch-only guardrail, boosting reserve/periphyton headroom, and restoring non-zero shrimp, juvenile, and readiness floors at the day-60/day-90 checkpoints.
4. [Completed] Updated the closed-system shrimp reproduction budget fixture to disable unrelated mortality/molt pressure so the accounting test stays focused on deterministic hatch bookkeeping, then reran the targeted core/data/scenario/harness regressions and recorded the remaining unrelated full-suite blocker.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo check -p tank_scenarios`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test events -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_harness controlled_ideal_reproduction_path_still_hatches -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture` (still fails only in the unrelated local `root_zone_oxygenation` compile break described above)

## Outstanding Risks

- A full `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture` sweep is still blocked by unrelated local `crates/tank_core/tests/root_zone_oxygenation.rs` compile errors against stale tracer APIs (`Engine::set_tracer`, `TickTrace.stages`), so only the targeted `tank_core` suites relevant to this task were revalidated.
